messages:
lucy_marketing: Quick sync — we need a tight copy refresh for the Hosted API, Dedicated, and Private landing pages before the webinar next Wed. Priority: hero lines, 1-2 supporting bullets, 2 CTA variants, and a short lead-routing spec. Can we iterate here and lock by EOD Monday? :calendar:

ben_dev_rel: SGTM. I'll sketch CTA variants and one-sentence value props for each page. Want them very dev-centric (examples + quickstart).

sam_engineering: Small nudge from eng: avoid hard SLAs in marketing copy (use 'SLA-backed options' or 'SLA-eligible') and for latency/cost claims use qualifiers like 'typical' or 'median' unless we have test numbers for the specific config.

maria_growth: On inbound routing — plan: Hosted API signups -> self-serve onboarding (no immediate SDR), mark as "high-velocity". Dedicated interest -> capture org size + use-case, route to AE queue. Private -> route to Solutions Eng + Sales. We'll need form fields: company, seats/GPUs, data classification, security contact. Also add an optional 'deployment timeline' dropdown.

dan_product: Draft accents per page: Hosted API: "Get started in minutes" + free credits, focus on SDKs + streaming. Dedicated: emphasize "reserved capacity, predictable throughput, cost controls" + mention canary rollouts. Private: highlight VPC, KMS/HSM, on-prem air-gapped option + audit logs.

lucy_marketing: Nice. Ben — want two hero lines per page, one focused on speed/cost and one on trust/compliance for Dedicated/Private. For Hosted, hero1 = speed/ease, hero2 = scale/price. Can you post variants?

ben_dev_rel: Posted raw variants below — feel free to iterate.

ben_dev_rel: Hosted API hero var A: "Production-grade LLM inference, without the infra."

ben_dev_rel: Hosted API hero var B: "Start with an API — scale from prototype to production."

ben_dev_rel: Dedicated hero var A: "Dedicated GPU pools for predictable throughput and cost."

ben_dev_rel: Dedicated hero var B: "Commit to capacity, get SLAs and consistent latency."

ben_dev_rel: Private hero var A: "Run inference inside your VPC or on-prem — no shared control plane."

ben_dev_rel: Private hero var B: "Full isolation, KMS/HSM support, and enterprise controls."

maria_growth: CTA thoughts: Hosted — [Try Hosted API], [See Pricing]. Dedicated — [Contact Sales], [Estimate Cost]. Private — [Talk to Solutions], [Request On-Prem Brief]. Add hidden utm fields to trace webinar traffic.

sam_engineering: Copy tweak suggestion: replace 'GPU' with 'GPU pools' or 'capacity' in hero if we aren't specifying exact hardware. Also, for Hosted API include a short line about model catalog and streaming.

lucy_marketing: Good call. Also want short microcopy under hero for each page (~1 sentence). Examples: Hosted: "REST + SDKs for text, chat, and embeddings with streaming and function calling." Dedicated: "Reserved capacity, autoscaling policies, and cost controls for predictable inference." Private: "Deploy behind your VPC with KMS integrations and audit logging for regulated workloads."

dan_product: For the landing templates we should include a small 'Why Redwood' blurb and a mini feature grid (Latency | Cost | Reliability | Controls) with one-line descriptors. That helps both GTM and engineering audiences.

ben_dev_rel: A/B test plan: run variant A (performance-first) vs variant B (trust-first) for Dedicated and Private. For Hosted, variant A emphasizes speed, B emphasizes SDKs + model catalog. Measure signups, demo requests, and time-to-first-request.

maria_growth: Routing details to add to the page JSON: "lead_type": [self-serve, AE, SE], "required_fields": [company, email, use_case, deployment_timeline], "tags": [webinar_2026_03, landing_dedicated_varA]. I'll make the full mapping doc and share.

deploy-bot: Staging preview deployed: https://staging.redwood-inference.internal/landing-copy/preview-1749001239 — passes basic lint and accessibility checks. :rocket:

lucy_marketing: Awesome. Next steps: Ben finalize hero + microcopy variants by EOD today. Maria publish lead-mapping JSON and wire it into the forms. Sam to confirm safe language around latency/cost. Dan will prepare the small feature grid content. We'll reconvene Monday AM for final sign-off. Thanks all. :thumbsup:
